# Condition: Parametric Functions
```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
set.seed(12)

library(tidyverse)

n_vals   <- c(100, 200, 500)
tp_vals  <- c(12, 30)
cor_vals <- c(0, 0.3, 0.8)
eps_vals <- c(.25, .5, 1)

conditions <- expand_grid(
  n_subj      = n_vals,
  time_points = tp_vals,
  cor_ss      = cor_vals,
  sig_eps   = eps_vals
) %>%
  mutate(
    cond_name = paste0(
      "n", n_subj,
      "_tp", time_points,
      "_cor", cor_ss,
      "_eps", sig_eps
    )
  )

n_mc <- 10

mc_results <- map_dfr(1:n_mc, function(iter){

  # For each condition run the simulation
  cond_outputs <- map2(
    seq_len(nrow(conditions)),
    conditions$cond_name,
    function(i, cname){

      n  <- conditions$n_subj[i]
      tp <- conditions$time_points[i]
      cs <- conditions$cor_ss[i]
      eps<- conditions$sig_eps[i]

      time <- seq(0, 1, length.out = tp)

      f1_t <- sqrt(12) * time - sqrt(12)/2
      f2_t <- rep(1, tp)

      run_mc(iter, n, tp, cs, eps, f1_t, f2_t)
    }
  )

  names(cond_outputs) <- conditions$cond_name
  
  if (iter %% 2 == 0) 
    message(sprintf("[%s] Done: iter %d", 
                    format(Sys.time(), "%H:%M:%S"), iter))

  tibble(iter = iter) %>%
    bind_cols(as_tibble(cond_outputs))
})

mc_results$n100_tp12_cor0_eps0.25[[1]]
```



```{r}
example <- mc_results$n100_tp12_cor0_eps0.25
metric_names <- names(example$fit_est)

condition_names <- names(mc_results)[-1]

summary_list <- lapply(
  condition_names,
  summarize_condition,
  mc_results = mc_results,
  metric_names = metric_names
)

names(summary_list) <- condition_names

summary_df <- as.data.frame(summary_list)
summary_df <- tibble::rownames_to_column(summary_df, "metric")
```


```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
saveRDS(mc_results, "param_fn_mc_results.R")
saveRDS(summary_df, "param_fn_dataframe.R")
```

```{r}
summary_df <- readRDS("param_fn_dataframe.R")
summary_df
```

```{r}
plot_simulation_metric(
  summary_df = summary_df,
  n_mc = n_mc,
  metric = "cfi",
  abline_value = .95,
  main_title = "Monte Carlo Performance: CFI"
)
```







#Condition: Non-parametric Functions

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
set.seed(12)

conditions <- expand_grid(
  n_subj      = n_vals,
  time_points = tp_vals,
  cor_ss      = cor_vals
) %>%
  mutate(
    cond_name = paste0(
      "n", n_subj,
      "_tp", time_points,
      "_cor", cor_ss
    )
  )

n_mc <- 100

mc_results_np <- map_dfr(1:n_mc, function(iter){

  # For each condition run the simulation
  cond_outputs <- map2(
    seq_len(nrow(conditions)),
    conditions$cond_name,
    function(i, cname){

      n  <- conditions$n_subj[i]
      tp <- conditions$time_points[i]
      cs <- conditions$cor_ss[i]

      time <- seq(0, 1, length.out = tp)

      Ly_ht <- lapply(seq_len(ncol(fda::growth$hgtf)), function(i)
        fda::growth$hgtf[,i])
      Lt_ht <- lapply(seq_len(ncol(fda::growth$hgtf)), function(i)
        (fda::growth$age - min(fda::growth$age))/
          (max(fda::growth$age - min(fda::growth$age))))
      fpca_ht <- FPCA(Ly_ht, Lt_ht)
      fit_ng_ht <- ConvertSupport(fromGrid = fpca_ht$workGrid,
                                      toGrid = time,
                                      phi = fpca_ht$phi)
      f1_t <- fit_ng_ht[,1]
      f2_t <- fit_ng_ht[,2]

      run_mc_np(iter, n, tp, cs, f1_t, f2_t)
    }
  )

  names(cond_outputs) <- conditions$cond_name

  tibble(iter = iter) %>%
    bind_cols(as_tibble(cond_outputs))
})

```


# Condition: Non-orthonormal functions

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
# ----- Apply FPCA -----
Ly_quad_c <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(Y_quad)), function(i) Y_quad[i,] - mean(Y_quad[i,], na.rm = TRUE))
Lt_quad <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(Y_quad)), function(i) time)

fpca_quad_c <- FPCA(Ly_quad_c, Lt_quad)
fit_ng_c <- ConvertSupport(fromGrid = fpca_quad_c$workGrid,
                                      toGrid = time,
                                      phi = fpca_quad_c$phi)
plot(fpca_quad_c)
```


```{r}
Y_test <- Y_quad_split$test
loading1 <- rep(1, n_time)
loading2 <- fit_ng_c[,1]

dat_lav <- as.data.frame(Y_test)
colnames(dat_lav) <- paste0("y", 1:n_time)
l1 <- paste0(loading1, "*y", 1:n_time, collapse = " + ")
l2 <- paste0(loading2, "*y", 1:n_time, collapse = " + ")

growth_mod_c <- paste0("
  eta1 =~ ", l1, "
  eta2 =~ ", l2, "

  # latent variances & covariance
  eta1 ~~ eta1
  eta2 ~~ eta2
  eta1 ~~ eta2

  # constant residual variance across time
  ", paste0(colnames(dat_lav), " ~~ vare*", colnames(dat_lav), collapse = "\n"), "
")

fit_c <- growth(
  model = growth_mod_c,
  data  = dat_lav,
  missing = "fiml", 
  em.h1.iter.max = 10000 
)

summary(fit_c, standardized = TRUE, fit.measures = TRUE)
```
